notes: Temporary diagnostic; no pacing, ACK, control-budget or notification-placement change. Same nine ascending twenty-second points as the normal-release low-rate sweep, with retained daemons and no overlapping builds/tests/Git packing.

Each pooled foreign Permit/Complete/Report receives a fresh Instant immediately before try_push. Successful pushes contribute to producer totals; failed pushes and synchronous local messages do not. A separate fresh timestamp immediately before the existing eventfd notify call measures producer deferral. Consumer handler observation uses another fresh timestamp.

The pre-push stamp precedes actual SPSC publication and can include producer preemption in that interval. This version does not measure time spent waiting in the producer's outgoing queue before try_push. In particular, a tiny Complete notify delay does not establish prompt completion production-to-owner delivery.

Load-only timing uses before/sent snapshots, not post-drain counters. Aggregate each message kind across endpoint workers. Means divide by their respective event counts. The signed observation-minus-notification residual is not a direct wakeup-latency measurement; a running consumer can observe before notification.

All timing censoring, failed-push and pending-notification counts are zero, and producer enqueued equals notified. Independent worker snapshots and in-flight messages cause producer/consumer interval count differences of up to 442 messages (0.181%). Raw counts and signed residuals are retained. Pending-notification gauges are omitted from additive throughput-counter deltas.

At 21G, permit pre-push→notify means 4.30/6.56us and pre-push→observation 17.40/14.26us. Complete means 0.147/0.104us versus 9.76/11.69us; report means 7.08/3.31us versus 11.40/12.75us. These intervals alone do not establish the throughput bottleneck.

Instrumented goodput varies against normal release: at 3G 2.58/2.72 versus 2.33/2.42, at 4G 2.79/2.36 versus 2.68/2.70, and unlimited 2.20/2.48 versus 2.22/2.57. Instrumentation and run variation prevent treating these as performance gains. The wide-range overload decline remains.

176 pure tests, 59 ignored kernel library regressions, Clippy and formatting passed. Tracing the compiled musl timing test found zero clock_gettime syscalls on the tested host; this does not promise the same clock implementation on every deployment.

All nine rate points have zero admission pressure, socket overflow/errors, malformed/invalid/duplicate/out-of-window/wrong-run/reordered records, inner UDP errors and outer IPv6 fragmentation. Selective payload repair remains unfinished.
Goodput excludes drain; throughput missing ratios and counter deltas include drain. 100% CPU is one core. ACK-buffer drops are a subset of queue_drops; units differ.
